Week 17, August 26, 2026 in St. Petersburg

Week 17-- At Least a Million Bug Bites and Counting

They don't bother me until 2:00 in the morning when they wake me up!

Thursday, 08/20 We had a really good lesson with our baptismal date Chris! He is so excited to have the Spirit with him always. Pray for him to be able to come to church this Sunday!

Friday, 08/21 We had Zone Conference!! It was really good; we talked about how we can find people's needs and desires that the Gospel of Jesus Christ can fulfill.

After ZoCo, we went to Wawa (a gas station) to get gas and have a phone call lesson with a friend. When we were pulling up, we realized our back right tire pressure was at 25, so it was a bit low. We started getting air and we realized it was actually really flat. So we called Elder Jenson (the mission vehicle coordinator) and he walked us through putting on the spare.

I got to stand on the tire iron to loosen and tighten the nuts and I felt a little bit (ok a lot) like Mary Poppins. It was really fun.

Saturday, 08/22 We did service for our bestie April!! She's a returning member whose good friend and roommate wants to progress towards baptism! She's actually so amazing, I love her so much!!

Sunday, 08/23 Maximus and his wife Sage came to church! We have had a couple of lessons with him and she grew up a member and wants to start coming back! They're both so awesome, but unfortunately they're moving to Ohio tomorrow.

Monday, 08/24 Sister Robison and I went out for Pho for dinner Monday evening! One of our members gave us a universal gift card for dinner, so we took a picture of us there to send to her :)

Tuesday, 08/25 Tuesday was p-day eve (as usual)! This week was fun, but it was so long. We had a lot of lessons fall through, but it was still a productive day because we stopped by almost all of our referrals!

Wednesday, 08/26 President told us today that Brad Wilcox is giving another message to the Florida Tampa mission! This time, he's coming to Tampa, and every missionary who is less than an hour's drive from the church building (without speeding) can come in person! We are approximately 45 minutes away, so that means we get to go see him in person next Saturday!!

Spiritual thought 2 Nephi 25:26 (page 100 of the Book of Mormon) And we talk of Christ, we rejoice in Christ, we preach of Christ, we prophesy of Christ, and we write according to our prophecies, that our children may know to what source they may look for a remission of their sins.

I love this scripture because I know my testimony of Jesus Christ has grown so much over my mission as I tell others about Jesus Christ. I invite you to center more of your conversations on Jesus Christ this week! I know that as you do this, your own testimony and love of Him will grow.

Stay tuned, Sister Christison
